lines.en: label sadgirls8:
scene hall_noon
We’re now merely two hours away from what will be a complete week since Makoto got the news about her father.
lines.zh: 再过两个小时,距离 Makoto 得知父亲的消息就满整整一周了。

lines.en: Oh, and I guess Nodoka got her ass kicked as well- but that sort of pales in comparison to the emotional rollercoaster I was forced onto just minutes later.
lines.zh: 哦,还有 Nodoka 也被揍了一顿——不过跟几分钟后我被迫坐上的那趟情绪过山车比起来,这就显得不值一提了。

lines.en: Since then, things have calmed down a little.
lines.zh: 从那以后,事情稍微平息了一些。

lines.en: Yumi was “indefinitely suspended” for attacking a fellow student.
lines.zh: Yumi 因为攻击同学被「无限期停学」。

lines.en: Nodoka’s black eyes have started to fade back to their usual color.
lines.zh: Nodoka 的黑眼圈开始褪回平常的颜色。

lines.en: Even Yasu has returned to normal.
lines.zh: 连 Yasu 都恢复正常了。

lines.en: Or...at least as normal as Yasu can possibly be.
lines.zh: 或者……至少回到了 Yasu 所能达到的极限正常。

lines.en: I also have no idea how I would have survived this last week without Imani (Who seems to have forgiven me following the Yumi incident) seeing as she’s taken over all the clerical stuff in Makoto’s absence.
lines.zh: 我也完全不知道,如果没有 Imani(Yumi 那件事之后她似乎原谅了我),这一周我怎么熬得过来——Makoto 不在的时候,她把所有文书活儿都接了过去。

lines.en: The only person who really {i}hasn’t{/i} shown any sign of improvement yet is Miku...
lines.zh: 唯一一个至今{i}还没{/i}显出任何好转迹象的人是 Miku……

lines.en: Who, understandably, is decaying from the inside out knowing that the beautiful mind of her best friend is rotting away in a dark room several miles from here.
lines.zh: 这也情有可原——她知道自己最好朋友那颗美丽的心灵,正在几英里外一间黑暗的房间里腐烂,于是自己也由内而外地枯萎着。

lines.en: It’s a room that she’s spent far more time in than me.
lines.zh: 那间房间,她待的时间比我多得多。

lines.en: It’s a room that she’s brave enough to return to while I would sooner slip back into the shadows and pretend none of this ever happened.
lines.zh: 她有足够的勇气一次次回到那间房间,而我宁愿溜回阴影里,假装这一切从未发生。

lines.en: But every time I look at Makoto’s desk, that wishful illusion is suffocated out of existence.
lines.zh: 可每当我看向 Makoto 的课桌,那点一厢情愿的幻觉就被掐得粉碎。

lines.en: And every time I watch her friend reflexively shift her gaze over to it to try and convince {i}herself{/i} this was all just some horrible dream, the truth is reinforced.
lines.zh: 而每当我看到她的朋友下意识地把目光移过去,试图说服{i}自己{/i}这一切只是场噩梦,真相就又被加固一次。

lines.en: scene black
But that’s just the way it goes, I guess.
lines.zh: 不过我想,事情本来就是这样。

lines.en: Sometimes, bad things happen to good people.
lines.zh: 有时候,坏事会发生在好人身上。

lines.en: More often than not, it seems like this pattern not only continues, but aggressively ramps up with each passing day.
lines.zh: 而且大多数时候,这种模式不仅会继续,还会随着每一天过去而变本加厉。

lines.en: Sometimes, bad things {i}won’t{/i} stop happening to good people.
lines.zh: 有时候,坏事会{i}一直不停{/i}地发生在好人身上。

lines.en: And while I wish that I could take these words to heart and truly feel something reminiscent of sympathy for the good person in question-
lines.zh: 虽然我希望自己能把这些话听进去,真正为那个好人感到一点类似同情的东西——

lines.en: I am one of those bad things.
lines.zh: 可我自己就是那些坏事之一。

lines.en: And it would make no sense at all for me, burdened by my constant obsession with navel-gazing, to slight them when I am of that same ilk.
lines.zh: 而一个被无休止的自我凝视所累的人,去轻慢与自己同类的人,是毫无道理的。

lines.en: I’ll remain quiet.
lines.zh: 我会保持沉默。

lines.en: I will wait.
lines.zh: 我会等待。

lines.en: And I will only moderately taint those that come to me with their concerns.
lines.zh: 而我只会适度地污染那些带着烦恼来找我的人。

lines.en: scene makotoback1
And I will only moderately taint those that come to me with their concerns...
lines.zh: 而我只会适度地污染那些带着烦恼来找我的人……

lines.en: : Mornin’, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 早上好,Sensei。

lines.en: : Good morning, Miku. Are you feeling any better?
lines.zh: : 早上好,Miku。你感觉好点了吗?

lines.en: : Not really. Was actually plannin’ on askin’ ya if I could maybe leave early today.
lines.zh: : 不太算。我其实正想问你,今天能不能早点走。

lines.en: : You don’t need to ask. You can leave literally whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 你不用问。你想什么时候走都行。

lines.en: : I’m honestly surprised you’re coming at all given everything that’s happened.
lines.zh: : 说实话,发生了这么多事,你还来上课,我挺意外的。

lines.en: scene makotoback2
: I’d feel too bad ditchin’ swim club when two of the members ain’t comin’ to school right now and one of em’s still too sore to actually do anything.
lines.zh: : 现在有两名队员不来学校,还有一个疼得什么都做不了,我要是还翘掉游泳社,心里会过意不去的。

lines.en: : Karin’s finally a captain, too. Bailin’ and leavin’ her with just one other girl would be way too rude.
lines.zh: : 而且 Karin 好不容易当上了队长。我要是撂挑子走人,只留她和一个女生,就太不礼貌了。

lines.en: : I think Karin’s mature enough to understand that you might want a little time away right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Karin 够成熟,能理解你现在可能想离开一阵子。

lines.en: scene makotoback3
: It’s fine, Sensei. Really. Gettin’ some exercise is good for me right now anyway. Helps get my mind off of stuff.
lines.zh: : 没关系的,Sensei。真的。现在运动一下对我有好处。能让我不去想那些事。

lines.en: : Sorry we ain’t been spendin’ much time together lately, though. All my free time’s been goin’ to Makoto and...yeah.
lines.zh: : 不过抱歉,最近我们没怎么在一起。我所有空闲时间都给了 Makoto,而且……嗯。

lines.en: : How is she?
lines.zh: : 她怎么样?

lines.en: scene makotoback4
: She ain’t changed much. Still really sad and...sayin’ a bunch of things that don’t make much sense to me.
lines.zh: : 她没怎么变。还是很伤心……还会说一堆我听不太懂的话。

lines.en: : She’s bein’ a little nicer to Maki, though. Hasn’t really yelled at her lately.
lines.zh: : 不过她对 Maki 好了一点。最近没怎么冲她吼了。

lines.en: scene makotoback3
: That wouldn’t have somethin’ to do with your little visit there, would it?
lines.zh: : 这该不会跟你那次上门拜访有关吧?

lines.en: if makotolust30 == True:
: Heard you were able to take Makoto’s mind off of stuff for almost a whole day.
lines.zh: : 听说你成功让 Makoto 差不多整整一天没去想那些事。

lines.en: : How’d ya do it? Lettin’ me and Maki in on your secret technique might be able to get her up and at ‘em again a little bit sooner.
lines.zh: : 你怎么办到的?把你的秘诀透露给我和 Maki,也许能让她早点振作起来。

lines.en: : I...think it’s best if my technique remains hidden.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得我的秘诀还是藏着比较好。

lines.en: else:
: You mean when I went into her room and tried having an actual conversation with her only for her to throw it back in my face?
lines.zh: : 你是说,我走进她房间,想跟她好好谈一谈,结果却被她当面甩回来那次?

lines.en: : I left before anything even happened. I doubt Makoto’s sudden change of heart has anything to do with me.
lines.zh: : 我在任何事发生之前就走了。我怀疑 Makoto 突然转变跟我没有关系。

lines.en: : Well, I obviously wasn’t there, so I’ve got no idea what actually went down. But I think it’s clear as day that you showin’ up definitely helped at least a {i}little.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯,我显然不在场,所以不知道到底发生了什么。但我觉得明摆着,你出现肯定至少帮了{i}一点{/i}忙。

lines.en: : Fact is, even if she didn’t seem like it at the time, Makoto loves ya. There ain’t no way she’d actually be mad about you tryin’ to be there for her.
lines.zh: : 事实是,就算她当时看起来不像,Makoto 是爱你的。她不可能真的因为你试图陪在她身边而生你的气。

lines.en: : Whatever the case, I hope she comes back soon. Class is weird without her.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样,我希望她快点回来。没有她,课都怪怪的。

lines.en: scene makotoback5
: It really is, ain’t it?!
lines.zh: : 真的是,对吧?!

lines.en: : I know we’re already pretty disorganized, but without Makoto actually givin’ people work to do, the whole heckin’ class has turned to chaos!
lines.zh: : 我知道我们本来就够乱的了,可没有 Makoto 给大家派活儿,整个班都他妈乱成一锅粥了!

lines.en: : I’m gettin’ dumber by the day, Sensei! And I was already in last place to begin with! I can’t afford this.
lines.zh: : 我一天比一天笨了,Sensei!而我本来就已经是最后一名了!我可承受不起。

lines.en: scene makotoback6
: Well, I can’t say I’ll be as much help as her...but I guess I could try actually {i}teaching{/i} you for a little while each day until she comes back.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我不敢说能像她那么有用……不过我想,在她回来之前,我可以试着每天真的{i}教{/i}你一会儿。

lines.en: scene makotoback7
: Anything involving math, though, you're probably better off asking Imani. She’s a lot better at-
lines.zh: : 不过凡是跟数学有关的,你还是去问 Imani 比较好。她比我强多了——

lines.en: : Makoto?...
lines.zh: : Makoto?……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: scene makotoback8
: {b}Guess who’s back, bitches.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}猜猜谁回来了,贱人们。{/b}

lines.en: : Makoto, what the heck are you doin’ here?! There ain’t no way you’re ready for this yet!
lines.zh: : Makoto,你到底来这儿干什么?!你不可能已经准备好回来上课了!

lines.en: : I think it might be time to cash in on that “going home early” thing, Miku. Take Makoto home before-
lines.zh: : Miku,我觉得是时候兑现那个「早点回家」了。趁还——先把 Makoto 送回家。

lines.en: scene makotoback9
: Guys...guys! I’m {i}fine!{/i} I was able to dress myself and everything.
lines.zh: : 各位……各位!我{i}没事{/i}!我自己穿好了衣服,什么都弄好了。

lines.en: : Besides, if I spend any longer inside of that room, I’m going to go fucking insane.
lines.zh: : 再说了,要是我在那间屋子里再多待一会儿,我他妈会疯掉的。

lines.en: scene makotoback10
: So, what’s new? Is Nodoka dead too? Is Yumi still a fucking bitch?
lines.zh: : 那么,有什么新鲜事吗?Nodoka 也死了吗?Yumi 还是那个他妈的贱人?

lines.en: : Has Sensei been completely fucking worthless without me here to do everything for him?
lines.zh: : 没有我在这里替他把所有事都办好,Sensei 是不是彻底他妈的废了?

lines.en: : Or is shit pretty much the same?
lines.zh: : 还是说一切照旧?

lines.en: : Makoto...
lines.zh: : Makoto……

lines.en: : What’s wrong? Taken aback by the fact that I’m now engaging in schoolgirl gossip rather than shunning it and burying my face in a fucking notebook instead?
lines.zh: : 怎么了?看到我现在也跟着聊起了女生八卦,而不是躲开它、把脸埋进他妈的笔记本里,你很吃惊?

lines.en: : Spit it out, Miku. Tell me how much has changed.
lines.zh: : 有话直说,Miku。告诉我变了多少。

lines.en: : Tell me how much happier everyone is without me here.
lines.zh: : 告诉我,没有我在,大家有多开心。

lines.en: scene makotoback11
: Well, that’s...certainly a look for her.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这……确实是她的一副打扮。

lines.en: : I wonder what happened?
lines.zh: : 我想知道发生了什么?

lines.en: : It’s not like Makoto to be anything less than perfect...and this sudden shift in aesthetic has made whatever the situation is impossible for me to ignore any longer.
lines.zh: : Makoto 向来都是完美无缺的……而她这副模样上的突然转变,让我再也没法无视眼前的情况了。

lines.en: : You haven’t heard anything from Sensei, have you?
lines.zh: : 你没从 Sensei 那儿听到什么吧?

lines.en: scene makotoback12
: Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami?

lines.en: scene makotoback13
: Okay! Since Miku didn’t have anything to say...how about you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 好吧!既然 Miku 没什么要说的……那你呢,Sensei?

lines.en: : I haven’t seen {i}you{/i} since my mom dragged you all the way to my fucking house to try and manipulate me into not being sad anymore.
lines.zh: : 自从我妈把你大老远拽到我他妈的家里、想操纵我别再难过之后,我就没见过{i}你{/i}了。

lines.en: : That’s not what happened, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 不是那样的,Makoto。

lines.en: : Hmm...I guess that can be kind of subjective, yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想这确实有点主观,是啊。

lines.en: : But something that definitely {i}did{/i} happen is you knocking one of my dad’s pictures off the wall and shattering it into a million pieces.
lines.zh: : 但有一件事{i}确实{/i}发生了:你把我爸的一张照片从墙上撞了下来,摔成了无数碎片。

lines.en: if makotolust30 == True:
: Was the mark you left on me not enough back then? You had to leave one on my fucking {i}hallway{/i} too?
lines.zh: : 那时候你留在我身上的印记还不够吗?你还非得在我他妈的{i}走廊{/i}上也留一个?

lines.en: else:
: Just couldn’t go home without leaving your mark, huh?
lines.zh: : 不留下点痕迹你就回不了家,是吧?

lines.en: : Did you know that a shard of glass managed to cut {i}right{/i} through my dad’s neck in that picture? Do you have any idea how fucking hysterical that is?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,有一片玻璃{i}正好{/i}划过了照片里我爸的脖子?你知道那有多他妈好笑吗?

lines.en: : I don’t even care that it was my favorite picture of us. That was genuinely {i}hilarious{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不在乎那是我最喜欢的一张合照。那真的太{i}好笑{/i}了。

lines.en: : Can the picture be replaced?
lines.zh: : 那张照片还能补回来吗?

lines.en: : With what? Wanna hang one up of yourself?
lines.zh: : 拿什么补?想挂一张你自己的?

lines.en: : You know that’s not what I meant...
lines.zh: : 你知道我不是那个意思……

lines.en: : Ooh! Maybe we can take one as a family! You can put your arm around me. I can look up at you with childish admiration in my eyes.
lines.zh: : 哦!也许我们可以拍一张全家福!你可以搂着我。我可以用孩子般仰慕的眼神抬头看你。

lines.en: : And then you could go into space and fucking suffocate because my life sucks and things like that just happen to me now.
lines.zh: : 然后你就可以上太空,然后他妈的窒息而死,因为我的人生烂透了,而这种事现在就是会发生在我的身上。

lines.en: scene makotoback14
: Um...Ayane?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Ayane?……

lines.en: : I know she’s kind of far away, but...you didn’t just hear what Makoto said...did you?
lines.zh: : 我知道她离得有点远,不过……你刚才没有听到 Makoto 说了什么吧……听到了吗?

lines.en: : I’ve never been so upset to have good hearing before...
lines.zh: : 我从来没有这么痛恨自己的听力好过……

lines.en: : That poor girl...I can’t even imagine how that must feel.
lines.zh: : 那可怜的孩子……我甚至想象不出那是什么感觉。

lines.en: : Is...Is there something we can do?...
lines.zh: : 我们……我们能做点什么吗?……

lines.en: : I have no idea...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : And I’d say that the best thing we can do while we figure that out is to pretend we {i}didn’t{/i} hear anything, but...
lines.zh: : 我本来想说,在想出办法之前,我们最好的做法就是假装什么都{i}没{/i}听见,不过……

lines.en: : I think that is about to become impossible.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这马上就要变得不可能了。

lines.en: scene makotoback15
: Makoto! Stop it! You don’t have to come back to school yet! There’s no rush at all!
lines.zh: : Makoto!别这样!你还不必回学校!完全不用着急!

lines.en: : Let’s...let’s go to the dorm! We can be alone there and I can tell ya all about how much school has sucked without you here!
lines.zh: : 我们……我们去宿舍吧!那里只有我们两个人,我可以好好跟你说,没有你在,学校有多烂!

lines.en: : Senpai! I know you told me to stay in {i}our{/i} office until I finished with all of your paperwork. But I just got a call from Makoto’s mom and-
lines.zh: : Senpai!我知道你让我待在{i}咱们{/i}的办公室里,把你的文书工作做完。可我刚接到 Makoto 她妈妈的电话,而且——

lines.en: : Oh, fuck.
lines.zh: : 哦,操。

lines.en: : Attention, please!
lines.zh: : 请注意!

lines.en: : {i}Senpai, what do we do? Her mom doesn’t even know she’s here right now. She told me she went missing.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Senpai,我们怎么办?她妈妈根本不知道她现在在这儿。她跟我说她离家出走了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Let’s let her talk...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就让她说吧……{/i}

lines.en: : I said {b}ATTENTION PLEASE!{/b}
lines.zh: : 我说了{b}请注意{/b}!

lines.en: : I know this isn’t the beginning of the school year anymore and that this is a really weird time to do this, but I’d like to take this opportunity to get to meet all of you!
lines.zh: : 我知道现在早就不是开学的时候了,而且挑这个时间做自我介绍实在很怪,不过我想借这个机会,正式认识一下大家!

lines.en: : My name is Makoto Miyamura and my dad is fucking dead.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Makoto Miyamura,我爸他妈的死了。

lines.en: : Holy shit...
lines.zh: : 我操……

lines.en: : Oh, no...
: I was really hoping...it wouldn’t be anything like that...
lines.zh: : 我真希望……不会是这种事……

lines.en: scene makotoback16
: I know that none of you have ever fucking cared about me, so this might just sound annoying, but I’d also like all of you to know that you won’t {b}have{/i} to be annoyed by me any longer!
lines.zh: : 我知道你们从来就没有他妈的在乎过我,所以这话听起来可能很烦人,不过我也想让你们所有人知道:你们以后不{b}会{/b}再被我烦到了!

lines.en: : Because I don’t fucking care anymore!
lines.zh: : 因为我他妈的已经不在乎了!

lines.en: scene makotoback17
: Schoolwork?! Studying?! Why waste time on things like that when life is finite and could be stripped from you at any moment?!
lines.zh: : 功课?!学习?!生命是有限的,随时可能被夺走,为什么还要把时间浪费在这种事上?!

lines.en: : What’s the point of striving to become better when it’s all for fucking nothing in the end?!
lines.zh: : 如果到头来全都是他妈的一场空,那努力变好还有什么意义?!

lines.en: : In fact, what’s the point of living at all when it’s just constant stress and suffering and pain with {i}liiiiiittle{/i} tiny bits of the good shit sprinkled on top?!
lines.zh: : 说真的,如果活着就只是持续的压力、折磨和痛苦,上面再撒那么{i}一丁点{/i}好东西,那活着到底有什么意义?!

lines.en: : We {i}do{/i} care about you, Makoto! Of course we care!
lines.zh: : 我们{i}在乎{/i}你的,Makoto!我们当然在乎!

lines.en: : Chika’s right! If you need anyone to talk to, we-
lines.zh: : Chika 说得对!如果你需要人倾诉,我们——

lines.en: : BZZZZZZZZZZZZT! {b}THE ANSWER IS THERE IS NO FUCKING POINT.{/b}
lines.zh: : 哔——!{b}答案是:他妈的没有任何意义{/b}。

lines.en: : Of course you’re going to act like you care now. Fucking look at me. You’d have to be fucking heartless  to ignore a girl giving a speech about her dead fucking dad.
lines.zh: : 你们现在当然会装作在乎。他妈的看看我。一个女孩在台上讲她死掉的爹,你们要是不理会,那得他妈的多没心没肺。

lines.en: : But where were you before this?
lines.zh: : 可在此之前你们在哪儿?

lines.en: : Where was fucking anyone other than Miku while I was suffering alone in my room?
lines.zh: : 我一个人在房间里受苦的时候,除了 Miku,他妈的还有谁在?

lines.en: : Which isn’t to say that any of you showing up would have fucking {i}helped{/i} me. But it really would have been the nice thing to do, right?
lines.zh: : 我也不是说你们来了就能他妈的{i}帮{/i}上什么忙。但那至少是件好事,对吧?

lines.en: : Like...I don’t know. Maybe a fucking card?
lines.zh: : 比如……我不知道。也许一张他妈的卡片?

lines.en: : They didn’t know, Makoto! We didn’t tell anyone because we thought it was too soon!
lines.zh: : 她们不知道啊,Makoto!我们没有告诉任何人,因为我们觉得太早了!

lines.en: scene makotoback18
: {b}TOO SOON?!{/b}
: My world is fucking exploding right now and you think it’s “too soon?!” For what?!
lines.zh: : 我的世界正在他妈的爆炸,而你觉得「太早了」?!早什么?!

lines.en: : Hey, don’t take your anger out on Miku! She’s been miserable all week long worrying about you!
lines.zh: : 嘿,别把火撒在 Miku 身上!她这一整周都在为你担心,难受得要死!

lines.en: scene makotoback19
: I’m not taking anything out on anyone! In fact, you’re {i}all{/i} pretty fucking great! It’s no wonder you haven’t bothered with {i}me!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我没有把火撒在任何人身上!事实上,你们{i}都{/i}他妈的挺棒的!怪不得你们懒得理{i}我{/i}!

lines.en: scene makotoback20
: I annoy you, right?
lines.zh: : 我让你们烦,对吧?

lines.en: : You hate that I’m the one who forces you out of what should be seven hours of pure fun and relaxation...
lines.zh: : 你们讨厌我,因为是我把你们从本该是七小时的纯粹玩乐和放松里拽出来……

lines.en: : You hate that you can’t spend all of your time with Sensei because I’m constantly making him spend time with {i}me{/i} instead...
lines.zh: : 你们讨厌自己不能把所有时间都花在 Sensei 身上,因为{i}我{/i}老是让他把时间花在我身上……

lines.en: : You hate the worksheets. And the quizzes. And the message board. And all of the other stuff I put together because something inside of me made me feel like I had to make my daddy proud one day.
lines.zh: : 你们讨厌那些习题。那些小测。还有留言板。以及我张罗起来的所有其他东西——因为我心里有什么东西让我觉得,总有一天我得让我爸爸为我骄傲。

lines.en: : And that if he saw how smart and responsible I’d become...that he’d be able to die happy.
lines.zh: : 那样他看到我变得这么聪明、这么有担当……就能安心地走了。

lines.en: scene makotoback21
: But, instead...
lines.zh: : 可结果……

lines.en: : He just {i}died.{/i}
lines.zh: : 他就那么{i}死了{/i}。

lines.en: : And now I’ll never know if he was happy or not.
lines.zh: : 而现在我永远也不会知道,他走的时候到底高不高兴。

lines.en: scene makotoback22
: But, I’ll tell you one thing I {i}do{/i} know...
lines.zh: : 不过,有一件事我{i}倒是{/i}知道……

lines.en: : It's that {i}I{/i} sure as fuck won’t ever be.
lines.zh: : 那就是,{i}我{/i}这辈子他妈的肯定不会高兴了。

lines.en: : There’s nothing left for me to work for.
lines.zh: : 我已经没有任何值得为之努力的东西了。

lines.en: : No reason to keep trying so hard for a bunch of people who see me for who I {i}really{/i} am.
lines.zh: : 没有理由再为一群看穿了我{i}真实{/i}模样的人那么拼命了。

lines.en: : An incorrigible...irritating...loud mouthed bitch.
lines.zh: : 一个无可救药的……惹人烦的……大嘴巴贱人。

lines.en: : Just like my mother.
lines.zh: : 跟我妈一个样。

lines.en: scene makotoback23
: Are you really sure we should be letting her ramble on like this? She’s clearly out of it and this is, like...reputation suicide.
lines.zh: : 你真的确定我们就这么任由她胡说下去?她明显已经不正常了,这简直就是……社会性死亡。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s what she wants?
lines.zh: : 也许她就是想要这样?

lines.en: : Senpai...
lines.zh: : Senpai……

lines.en: : Who says starting over has to be a bad thing?
lines.zh: : 谁说重新开始一定是坏事?

lines.en: : No one. {i}I’m{/i} not saying that. I just think that we should maybe wait until she’s...oh, I don’t know- not running away from home and giving speeches to the class while cosplaying as a fucking zombie.
lines.zh: : 没人说那是坏事。{i}我{/i}也没那么说。我只是觉得,我们也许该等她……哦,我不知道——等她不再离家出走、不再扮成他妈的僵尸给全班演讲的时候。

lines.en: : I just don’t want her going out in some blaze of glory while everybody else sits back and watches.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想看着她在一片烈焰中壮烈收场,而其他人就坐在那儿看着。

lines.en: : Who says everyone’s just sitting back and watching?
lines.zh: : 谁说所有人就只是坐在那儿看着?

lines.en: : Senpai, what are you talking about? Are we not seeing the same thing right now?
lines.zh: : Senpai,你在说什么?我们看到的难道不是同一件事吗?

lines.en: : Stop staring at me and take a look for yourself.
lines.zh: : 别盯着我看,你自己看看。

lines.en: scene makotoback24
: Shut up...
lines.zh: : 闭嘴……

lines.en: : Shut up...shut up...shut up...
lines.zh: : 闭嘴……闭嘴……闭嘴……

lines.en: : Hearing you say those things...
lines.zh: : 听你说那些话……

lines.en: : It brings back too many bad memories...
lines.zh: : 它勾起了太多糟糕的回忆……

lines.en: scene makotoback25
Sometimes, all it takes to reduce the suffering is someone you can relate to.
lines.zh: 有时候,减轻痛苦所需要的,只是一个你能与之共鸣的人。

lines.en: Someone who climbs out of the woodwork and into your arms...that you can abhor in moments of joyous splendor and admire in stretches of constant pain.
lines.zh: 一个从木缝里爬出来、爬进你怀里的人……一个你能在欢欣的时刻厌弃、在绵长的痛苦中仰慕的人。

lines.en: I let her speak because I knew this would happen.
lines.zh: 我让她说下去,是因为我知道这会发生。

lines.en: I knew it from the moment I saw Ami’s face.
lines.zh: 从我看见 Ami 脸的那一刻起,我就知道了。

lines.en: Because Ami is a girl I have cherished and loved.
lines.zh: 因为 Ami 是我珍视过、爱过的女孩。

lines.en: She is a girl I understand.
lines.zh: 她是我理解的女孩。

lines.en: And Makoto?
lines.zh: 而 Makoto 呢?

lines.en: Makoto will become one of those too.
lines.zh: Makoto 也会成为其中之一。

lines.en: But for now, she needs to suffer.
lines.zh: 但现在,她需要受苦。

lines.en: For now, she needs to cry.
lines.zh: 现在,她需要哭。

lines.en: scene makotoback26
: {b}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!{/b}

lines.en: : Uhh...okay! If your name isn’t Makoto, Ami, Miku, or Sensei, please leave the room right now! We’re going to have class in the gym or something!
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧!如果你的名字不是 Makoto、Ami、Miku 或 Sensei,请立刻离开教室!我们要去体育馆上课什么的!

lines.en: : I actually think Miss Watabe’s class is in the gym right now.
lines.zh: : 实际上,Watabe 老师的班现在好像就在体育馆。

lines.en: : Then it looks like we’re having a joint period! Go, go, go!
lines.zh: : 那看来我们要上一节合班课了!走,走,走!

lines.en: scene black
The girls filter out of the room paying minimal attention to what’s happening in the front of the class despite a burning interest to act in opposition to that.
lines.zh: 女孩们陆续走出教室,尽管心里极度想反着来,却几乎没表现出对教室前面发生的事有多少关注。

lines.en: Imani is the last one out, sliding the door closed after locking eyes with me and silently admitting that sometimes I can, whether it be intentional or not, actually know what needs to be done.
lines.zh: Imani 是最后一个出去的,她和我四目相对之后把门拉上,无声地承认:有时候,不管是不是有意的,我确实知道该做什么。

lines.en: Those moments are few and far between. And frankly, this moment isn’t even one of triumph for {i}me{/i} as all I did was clear a path for the only person actually able to do anything when it comes to pain like this.
lines.zh: 这样的时刻少之又少。而且说实话,这一刻甚至谈不上是{i}我的{/i}胜利,因为我所做的,只是为唯一一个真正能对这种痛苦做点什么的人清出了一条路。

lines.en: scene makotoback27
: Never say you won’t ever be happy again! It’s a lie! A lie I told myself over and over when this happened to me!
lines.zh: : 永远别说你再也不会幸福了!那是谎话!是这件事发生在我身上时,我一遍又一遍对自己说的谎话!

lines.en: : Ami’s right! This’ll sting forever, but there’s plenty more good stuff out there! Good stuff I wanna see and experience with my best friend!
lines.zh: : Ami 说得对!这会一直痛下去,但外面还有很多好东西!是我想和我最好的朋友一起去看、一起去经历的好东西!

lines.en: : You think we woulda made it as far as we did if we just gave up?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得,如果我们当初就这么放弃了,我们还能走到今天吗?!

lines.en: : Yes, you’re annoying! Yes, I hate the stupid worksheets! And yes, I kinda hate {i}you{/i} when you spend every day trying to steal my uncle away from me!
lines.zh: : 对,你很烦人!对,我讨厌那些破习题!还有,你每天想方设法把我舅舅从我身边抢走的时候,我确实有点讨厌{i}你{/i}!

lines.en: : But I’d never wish this sort of pain on anybody in the whole wide world!
lines.zh: : 可我绝对不会把这种痛苦加到这世上任何一个人身上!

lines.en: scene makotoback28
: And you need to know that life goes on.
lines.zh: : 而你需要知道,生活还要继续。

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : There isn’t a day that goes by where I don’t miss my parents. I can’t even cross the street without having to force back tears.
lines.zh: : 我没有一天不想我的父母。我甚至过个马路都要强忍着眼泪。

lines.en: : But Sensei makes me happy now! And you still have your mom!
lines.zh: : 可现在 Sensei 让我快乐!而且你还有你妈妈!

lines.en: : Let her be that for you! Stop closing yourself off and let {i}her{/i} make you happy instead!
lines.zh: : 让她成为你的那个人吧!别再把自己关起来,让{i}她{/i}来让你快乐!

lines.en: : That’s what your dad would have wanted, isn’t it?!
lines.zh: : 那正是你爸爸希望看到的,不是吗?!

lines.en: : Wouldn't he have wanted you to be happy?!
lines.zh: : 他难道不希望你幸福吗?!

lines.en: scene makotoback29
: But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : It’s so hard!
lines.zh: : 太难了!

lines.en: : I can’t stop thinking about him! About what his final thoughts must have been! About how I never got to say goodbye!
lines.zh: : 我忍不住一直想着他!想着他最后的念头会是什么!想着我连再见都没来得及说!

lines.en: : I know it’s hard! But it'll only get easier from here, Makoto! So don’t give up just yet!
lines.zh: : 我知道这很难!可从现在开始,只会越来越容易,Makoto!所以先别放弃!

lines.en: : Keep being the same annoying you! Because even if we’re not there for you all the time and forget to make cards when things are horrible, we {i}do{/i} care!
lines.zh: : 继续做那个烦人的你吧!因为就算我们不能时时刻刻陪着你,就算事情糟糕的时候我们会忘了做卡片,我们{i}真的{/i}在乎你!

lines.en: : And we can cry together when no one else understands our pain!
lines.zh: : 而当没有人理解我们的痛苦时,我们可以一起哭!

lines.en: : I don’t want to cry anymore! I don’t want to cry!
lines.zh: : 我不想再哭了!我不想再哭了!

lines.en: scene makotoback30
: Well, too bad because I do!
lines.zh: : 那可真不巧,因为我想哭!

lines.en: scene black
I leave the classroom as well and retreat to the gym to meet back up with the rest of the girls.
lines.zh: 我也离开了教室,退到体育馆,和其余的女孩们汇合。

lines.en: There was no reason for me to be in that classroom any longer.
lines.zh: 我已经没有理由再待在那间教室里了。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
But what I heard from Ami in the coming hours is that things worked out okay.
lines.zh: 但在接下来的几个小时里,我从 Ami 那儿听说,事情的结果还不错。

lines.en: That Makoto went back home with Miku and has decided to take a little time off of school for the foreseeable future.
lines.zh: Makoto 跟 Miku 一起回了家,而且决定在可预见的未来里休一段时间不去上学。

lines.en: That she wouldn’t try running away again. And, if she ever felt the urge to, she’d talk to her mom first.
lines.zh: 说她不会再尝试离家出走了。而且,如果再有过这种冲动,她会先跟她妈妈谈。

lines.en: Of course, those are just words. And she may very well act out against them.
lines.zh: 当然,这些都只是说说而已。她也完全可能反其道而行。

lines.en: scene black
But something about the way they sound when released by the mouth of a third party makes me want to trust them a little more this time.
lines.zh: 可当这些话从一个第三者的嘴里说出来时,不知怎的,让我这一次更想相信它们一些。

lines.en: You see, the thing with words is that they’ll always be ephemeral.
lines.zh: 你要知道,语言这东西,永远是转瞬即逝的。

lines.en: And that, with how rapidly our lives and the world itself are changing, they’re really just air in the end.
lines.zh: 而且,考虑到我们的生活和这个世界本身变化得如此之快,它们到头来真的只是一团空气。

lines.en: And so Makoto will suffer as she remembers the life of the man she loved most.
lines.zh: 于是,Makoto 会在回忆她最爱那个男人的一生时受苦。

lines.en: But that’s fine.
lines.zh: 但那没关系。

lines.en: Because if she listens hard enough, she’ll still be able to hear his voice in the whispers of the world itself.
lines.zh: 因为只要她足够用心地听,她依然能在世界本身的低语中听见他的声音。

lines.en: And that gift from the sky should be enough to keep her grounded.
lines.zh: 而那份来自天空的礼物,应该足够让她站稳在地上。

lines.zh: {i}不过她需要一个人待一阵子……{/i}
